autoRotate

Gesture latch — false stops the idle drift (OrbitControls.autoRotate).

(module scope)

Damped current pose — feed surface.set_orbit after update().

update

One frame of integration — auto-rotate advances the target while no pointer is captured, then every channel damps toward its target. Allocation-free. Returns true when the pose changed (the caller pushes set_orbit + fires CHANGE consumers).

  • @param dt Frame delta in seconds.

getDistance

Current damped distance — the label-fade/zoom-reveal input.

setTarget

Moves the orbit target (world point).

setPose

Jumps the pose (save/restore arms — targets AND currents snap).

addEventListener

Registers a START/END/CHANGE listener.

removeEventListener

Removes a registered listener.

dispose

Unbinds every listener + clears pointer state.

bindOrbit

Binds pointer/wheel input on canvas to a damped orbit rig. The rig never touches the camera itself — consumers read the pose fields after update(dt) and push them into the engine (set_orbit) or a three camera (the math is backend-agnostic by design).

  • @param canvas The scene's input surface.
  • @param spec Gesture + clamp options.

dirty

Pose-dirty latch — setTarget/setPose change the pushed pose even when the damped channels are already settled.

pointers

Pointers currently captured on the canvas (1 = drag, 2 = pinch).

pinchSpan

Span between the first two captured pointers — the pinch baseline.

pinchDistance

The distance at pinch start — multiplied by the live ratio.
